mapper.sql: create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version
mapper.select: select o.transfer_no as transferNo, o.status as status, case when o.status = 'TF_P' then '移動登録完了' else coalesce(nullif(trim(st.dict_label), ''), o.status) end as statusLabel, o.transfer_fm_wh_cd as sourceWhCd, coalesce(nullif(fw.wh_nm, ''), o.transfer_fm_wh_cd) as sourceWarehouse, o.transfer_to_wh_cd as destWhCd, coalesce(nullif(tw.wh_nm, ''), o.transfer_to_wh_cd) as destWarehouse, o.transfer_to_loc_cd as destLocCd, ( select min(d2.loc_cd) from bss_transfer_detail d inner join bss_inventory_detail d2 on d2.id = d.inventory_detail_id where d.transfer_no = o.transfer_no and d.delete_flg = '0' ) as sourceLocCd, ( select string_agg(distinct d.source_pallet_no, ', ') from bss_transfer_detail d where d.transfer_no = o.transfer_no and d.delete_flg = '0' ) as sourcePalletNo, ( select string_agg(distinct d.dest_pallet_no, ', ') from bss_transfer_detail d where d.transfer_no = o.transfer_no and d.delete_flg = '0' ) as destPalletNo, coalesce(nullif(trim(ru.nick_name), ''), o.transfer_registered_by) as registrar, nullif(o.transfer_registered_at, '') as registeredDate, coalesce(nullif(trim(cu.nick_name), ''), o.completed_by) as completer, nullif(o.completed_at, '') as completedDate, nullif(o.memo, '') as memo, nullif(o.completion_memo, '') as completionMemo from bss_transfer o left join mast_warehouse fw on fw.wh_cd = o.transfer_fm_wh_cd left join mast_warehouse tw on tw.wh_cd = o.transfer_to_wh_cd left join sys_dict_data st on st.dict_type = 'bss_transfer_status' and st.dict_value = o.status left join sys_user ru on ru.user_name = o.transfer_registered_by left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = o.completed_by where o.delete_flg = '0' and o.transfer_no = #{transferNo} limit 1

select o.transfer_no from bss_transfer o inner join bss_transfer_detail d on d.transfer_no = o.transfer_no and d.delete_flg = '0' where o.delete_flg = '0' and o.status = #{status} and d.dest_pallet_no = #{palletNo} order by o.transfer_no limit 1
mapper.update: update bss_transfer set status = #{status}, completed_by = #{completedBy}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, completion_memo = #{completionMemo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_no = #{transferNo} and status = #{fromStatus} and delete_flg = '0'

update bss_transfer_detail set status = #{status}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_no = #{transferNo} and delete_flg = '0'

update bss_transfer set status = #{status}, completed_by = null, completed_at = null, completion_memo = null, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_no = #{transferNo} and status = #{fromStatus} and delete_flg = '0'

update bss_transfer_order_detail set moved_qty = greatest(coalesce(moved_qty, 0) - #{moveQty}, 0), status = #{status}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} and detail_no = #{detailNo} and delete_flg = '0'

update bss_transfer_order o set status = #{status}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where o.transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} and o.delete_flg = '0' and exists ( select 1 from bss_transfer_order_detail d where d.transfer_request_no = o.transfer_request_no and d.delete_flg = '0' and coalesce(d.moved_qty, 0) < coalesce(d.used_qty, 0) )
mapper.select: select id as id, transfer_no as transferNo, status as status, transfer_fm_wh_cd as transferFmWhCd, transfer_to_wh_cd as transferToWhCd, transfer_to_loc_cd as transferToLocCd, transfer_registered_by as transferRegisteredBy, transfer_registered_at as transferRegisteredAt, completed_by as completedBy, completed_at as completedAt, canceled_by as canceledBy, canceled_at as canceledAt, memo as memo, completion_memo as completionMemo, delete_flg as deleteFlg, version as version from bss_transfer where transfer_no = #{transferNo} and delete_flg = '0' for update

select d.detail_no as detailNo, d.item_code as itemCode, d.item_name as itemName, coalesce(nullif(cl.dict_label, ''), d.classification) as classification, d.classification as classificationCode, d.inventory_detail_id as inventoryDetailId, d.storage_qty as storageQty, d.move_qty as moveQty, d.lost_damaged_qty as lostDamagedQty, d.disposal_qty as disposalQty, d.source_pallet_no as sourcePalletNo, d.dest_pallet_no as destPalletNo, d.transfer_request_no as transferRequestNo, d.transfer_request_detail_no as transferRequestDetailNo, d.remarks as remarks from bss_transfer_detail d left join sys_dict_data cl on cl.dict_type = 'bss_classification' and cl.dict_value = d.classification where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.transfer_no = #{transferNo} order by d.detail_no

select d.id as id, d.transfer_request_no as transferRequestNo, d.detail_no as detailNo, d.status as status, d.item_code as itemCode, d.item_name as itemName, d.storage_qty as storageQty, d.used_qty as usedQty, d.moved_qty as movedQty, d.pallet_no as palletNo from bss_transfer_order_detail d where d.delete_flg = '0' and d.transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} and d.detail_no = #{detailNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update bss_transfer_order_detail set moved_qty = coalesce(moved_qty, 0) + #{moveQty}, status = #{status}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} and detail_no = #{detailNo} and delete_flg = '0'

update bss_transfer_order o set status = #{status}, update_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where o.transfer_request_no = #{requestNo} and o.delete_flg = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from bss_transfer_order_detail d where d.transfer_request_no = o.transfer_request_no and d.delete_flg = '0' and coalesce(d.moved_qty, 0) < coalesce(d.used_qty, 0) )
